meta.source: Three page mockups: Homepage, MyPothecary Extracts category, Lion's Mane product page

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground: the rice-paper cream of every page; forest night in dark.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, product tiles, category tiles, select and stepper fields.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: thumbnail wells, disclaimer box ground, image placeholders.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Ink band sections (Our Approach, UAE, Mushrooms Without Compromise). Always dark in both themes.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Brand forest green, constant. Primary buttons on paper, brush strokes, UAE panel.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Brand gold, constant. Band CTA fill, icon rings and eyebrows on ink bands. Never text on paper (fails contrast).

tokens.name: hanko
tokens.usage: Hanko-red rising sun. Decorative only (the sun disc, a seal mark). 3.6:1 on paper: never text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Card subtitles, captions, metadata on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk.

tokens.name: on-band
tokens.usage: Headings and body on band and forest.

tokens.name: on-band-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy on band and forest.

tokens.name: rust
tokens.usage: Small caps text links with an arrow (SHOP FRESH →) on paper and paper-raised.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill: forest on paper, gold in dark.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover/pressed fill.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label and icon on action and action-hover.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Label on gold fills.

tokens.name: price
tokens.usage: Prices on paper and paper-raised.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between feature columns and sections; card edges. Decorative, not a control border.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: quantity stepper, select, outline button. 3:1 on paper and paper-raised.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors and out-of-stock text on paper and paper-raised; pair with a word, never colour alone.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Category hero title. One per page.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Product name on the product page; band titles.

styles.name: heading-l
styles.usage: Section titles (Shop Extracts, Why Ours, What's Inside), always with a brush underline.

styles.name: heading-m
styles.usage: Benefit titles, How to Use, category tile titles.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: Product line under the product name.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Small-batch mushroom extracts crafted with traditional wisdom.
styles.usage: Hero and band intros, product tagline, benefit descriptions.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Card subtitles, feature labels, ingredient names.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

styles.name: price-l
styles.usage: Product page price, in price colour.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Product card price, in price colour.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Kicker above band and section titles; uppercase.

styles.name: link-caps
styles.usage: Arrow links on category tiles; uppercase, rust.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, select values, stepper digits.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps inside buttons.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: title to subtitle on cards; thumbnail gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card inner padding top; stepper to button gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; grid gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Product grid gutter; space under a brush heading.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Column gaps; block spacing inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile; band inner padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero padding; space before the footer landscape.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width, centred, 24px side gutters.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Thumbnails, selects, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Buttons, quantity stepper, disclaimer box.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Product cards, category tiles, hero photo, Why-Ours cards.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Gold icon rings, the hanko sun.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Product cards, category tiles, Why-Ours cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Card hover.
